articleTitle: Environmental sound classification based on pitch shifting
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Environmental sound classification (ESC) is a challenging problem. Environmental sound classification is different from traditional music classification and speech classification because of its non-stationary characteristics. The use of convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify environmental sound is faced with the problems of unequal audio data sample length and single data, which leads to the generation of overfitting and low classification accuracy. In order to solve these problems, we proposed a waveform stretching method to solve the problem of unequal audio length, and adopted the audio data enhancement method with pitch shifting to prevent the over-fitting phenomenon caused by the single data. Log-Mel features are extracted and classified using an improved Lenet network. Our experimental results show that the proposed method achieves 95.65% accuracy on Urbansound8K.

articleTitle: Noise removal algorithm based on point cloud classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The point cloud data obtained by 3D scanning equipment inevitably has noise. To remove the noise, we propose a point cloud denoising method. In this experiment, according to the characteristics of noise, noise is divided into two types: large-scale and small-scale. Then to remove large scale noise, we use statistical and radius filtering. For smallscale noise dividing point cloud into patches and each patch is fitted into a surface, thus converted into similarity cloud learning and the removal of surface noise is formulated as a convex optimization problem. Experimental results show that the proposed method is superior to the competing method.

articleTitle: Botnet Detection with Deep Neural Networks Using Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the vast popularity of IoT (Internet-of-Things), cloud computing and edge computing, botnet attacks are flourishing nowadays. Meanwhile, deep learning-powered models are widely deployed to secure the network and applications. However, deep learning-based botnet detection is a challenging problem due to its extensive network traffic volume, complex feature engineering and the lack of the benchmark dataset for evaluation. With the aim of improving the performance of botnet detection, this paper firstly designs a feature extraction method by using the effective payload from each network packet. Then, a feature selection algorithm is designed based on the comparison and trade-off on the length of the extracted packets and the trained models’ performance. By choosing a reasonable number of packets and an appropriate length of bytes as feature vectors, a deep learning model is designed and evaluated for botnet detection. The experimental results prove that the designed deep neural network achieves 98% accuracy with low cost.

articleTitle: Application of 5G mobile communication technology in modern power supply services
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Modern power supply service system can provide power users with reliable, convenient, efficient, and intelligent new power supply services, and facilitate the strategic transformation of the power grid. The modern power supply service system will bring a new energy ecology to the power grid, as well as new communication requirements.This paper analyzes the technical characteristics of 5G mobile communication technology, and discusses the application prospects of 5G technology in several typical scenarios of modern power supply services, including AMI, demand response,smart electricity utilization, electric vehicle operation management, distributed energy resources utilization and smart power supply service hall. This paper also discusses the application of 5G virtual power private network in modern power supply services.

articleTitle: Multi objective optimization of microgrid based on Improved Multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-objective optimization mathematical model is established based on the comprehensive consideration of economy, environment and battery circulating power in the process of microgrid dispatching. Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO), this paper proposes a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm based on fuzzy clustering (FCMOPSO), which introduces fuzzy clustering analysis in the iterative process to find the optimal cluster solution of each generation. Compared with MOPSO, FCMOPSO enhances the stability and global search ability of the algorithm, and makes the Pareto front distribution more uniform in the optimization results. After obtaining the Pareto optimal solution set, according to the importance of each target, the fuzzy model identification is used to find the optimal scheme under different conditions from the optimal solution set.

articleTitle: Research on an Automatic Sorting System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The sorting and handling of materials is an essential part of the automated production line. However, the traditional sorting method cannot meet the current development needs due to low efficiency. This paper proposes an automatic sorting system by pneumatic robots with machine vision technology. The system is composed of machine vision unit, automatic conveying unit, pneumatic robot unit and controller unit. The machine vision software Halcon is selected to recognize the image accurately, and a sorting execution device is designed which is combined with pneumatic manipulator and pushing mechanism. Programmable controller (PLC) is selected as the controller, and the hardware and software of the control system are designed. Finally, the system is simulated and the results show that the system can quickly realize the sorting of materials of different shapes and colours, and improve the efficiency and accuracy of sorting.

articleTitle: Research on face recognition technology based on an improved LeNet-5 system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the continuous development of technology, face recognition technology became highly valued in the current society. In this paper, a deep convolutional neural network structure with deconvolution is constructed with the Keras framework based on the theory of deep learning. The LeNet-5 network structure is improved by adding the deconvolution layer. Meanwhile, a face recognition system is also designed. The performed experiment demonstrates that this method exhibits high accuracy and can accurately identify faces presented in videos.

articleTitle: Mapping and Path Planning Simulation of Mobile Robot Slam Based on Ros
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Research on SLAM mapping and autonomous navigation of ROSmobile robots is increasing. It is very important to conduct simulation research on SLAM construction and autonomous navigation of mobile robot in real environment. It is helpful to discover and correct the problems existing in the mapping and autonomous navigation of MOBILE robot in SLAM in real time. The mobile robot simulation model is built by URDF and displayed in Gazebo simulation software. The simulation model of mobile robot shown in Gazebo is studied experimentally. The results show that the constructed mobile robot can construct 2d raster map in Gazebo simulation environment by using Gmapping function package in ROS combined with keyboard control, and display the constructed 2D raster map in Rviz. Finally, load yamL file under move_base function package in ROS in Launch file, and realize simple path planning of mobile robot in 2D raster map by combining 2D Nav Goal in Rviz.

articleTitle: Research on Middle Platform Construction and Large Data Analysis of Power Enterprises Based on Aliyun
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Electric power enterprises upgrade their business support by building a shared architecture in the middle platform. Big data analysis is a typical means for further comprehensive application of data. This research integrates business system source data, including relational and object-based model, real-time, historical and record-based data, and builds power enterprise data and service platform based on Aliyun’s computing infrastructure to form an extensible service sharing system. Using the big data analysis tools in cloud environment for data reprocessing, the data processing results are replenished to the platform as incremental data and can be accessed through service, which drives the rapid construction of various types of applications, including data resource management and index analysis. By combining the construction of the middle-platform with the analysis of large data, the data resources of the existing business are managed in a standardized way. Data supporting high-level business is constantly derived iteratively. The total amount of data resources has increased in an orderly manner and the value has been continuously enhanced.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Keyphrase Extraction from Single Document Based on Bert
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Keyphrase extraction is the task of automatically selecting the phrases that best describe the text content in the document. Keyphrase extraction has essential research significance in text classification, text clustering, document retrieval. In this paper, we propose an unsupervised keyphrase extraction model based on Bert called BWRank. We use Bert as the pre-trained language model and use whitening operation to reconstruct document and phrase embeddings and reduce dimensionality. Finally, we add word frequency information in the scoring stage. Experiments show that our model outperforms other models on two datasets.

articleTitle: Exploration of computer vision and image processing technology based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Face recognition is one of the important applications of computer vision. With the continuous development of computer technology and electronic information technology and the development of image recognition and pattern recognition, with the deepening of artificial intelligence research, face recognition has become a popular research topic. For the research of computer vision and image processing based on OpenCV, the essay uses a cascade classifier based on Haar-like feature for face detection and eye detection. Through the face recognition scheme based on principal component analysis (PCA) of AdaBoost, the eigenface and mean face are generated, and the face is reconstructed and recognized. In addition, the corresponding experiments and analysis of face detection and face recognition are also made, which achieves a high detection rate and recognition rate in the case of sufficient light.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Marine Datasets Based on DCGAN Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, the deep learning method is applied to the ship detection SAR datasets to enlarge the existing SAR images of ships.This paper first introduces the basic knowledge of convolutional neural networks, and also introduces the common convolutional neural network structure.Secondly, this paper introduces the generative adversarial network GAN,, analyzes the GAN principle and network structure according to the objective function, introduces the training method of the GAN model, and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of GAN.This introduces the DCGAN network model that combines the above two, analyzes its basic knowledge and network structure, and the improvement of GAN model, and introduces the training process in detail.Finally, we compare the loss function images generated by DCGAN and GAN and summarize the lessons.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Management System for Electric Tools Based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to better serve the production of power grid and achieve goal of information management of power tools and instruments in the whole life cycle, this paper analyzes problems faced by power tools and instruments management, studies storage and system structure of power tools and instruments production data, and designs management system of power tools and instruments based on RFID. By means of the integrated intelligent workstation near the RFID terminal to ensure automatic registration of warehouse management of tools and instruments, by means of acquiring data collected by the RFID reader set on the shelf to make a real-time inventory of tools and instruments in warehouse, by means of access control alarm service to guarantee information registration of abnormal ex-warehouse and in-warehouse and alarm prompt, by means of movement trajectory of indoor positioning terminal tracking tools and instruments to realize regional positioning, by means of integrated management system of the far RFID terminal to view and manage tool information, operation instruction and staff information. The system has been successfully applied to Qingyuan Pumped Storage Power Station of China Southern Power Grid.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning based Intelligent Propagation Model for RSRP prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Wireless propagation model modeling is of great significance for system design and base station deployment of 5G network-Traditional models are limited to a variety of propagation environments.A deterministic model based on ray tracing requires a great deal of computation.Therefore, we propose a deep learning-based fitting method.However, when the deep learning model is used for wireless transmission model modeling, it usually requires a lot of manual design features. In order to solve this problem, in the feature engineering stage, we proposed a feature generator based on the machine learning algorithm-Gradient Boosting Decision Tree to automatically characterize the combined features.Eight features of manual design based on HATA pathloss formula.In the model stage, an intelligent wireless propagation model based on BP neural network is established-Combined features, manual design features, original engineering parameters, geographic parameters and other data are used as inputs of neural networks for radio wave propagation model modeling and RSRP(Reference Signal Receiving Power) regression prediction.We quantitatively compare the performance of several machine learning algorithms in modeling wireless channels.Our results show that the overall performance of the deep neural network algorithm using the GBDT(Gradient Boosting Decison Tree) feature generator as auxiliary is better than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of GIS Basic Data Quality Management Tools for Power Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The GIS based data quality is the premise of all data processing and analysis, and it has great significance for carrying out GIS business applications and improving the level of practical system. However, due to the adjustment of the platform model, the new and old system data migration, wrong data source input and other reasons, the power grid GIS basic data quality issues are serious. In order to solve the problem of quality management of stock data, this paper designs and implements a GIS data quality management tool based on graph logic processing algorithm, which includes data source management, configuration management, query management and so on. Test results show that the use of the tool technology and optimization of the relevant management process can continuously improve the power grid GIS based data quality, and enhance the practical application of GIS large data.

articleTitle: Integration Implementation and Application of Power Grid GIS Platform and Production Management System Based on ESB
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Geographic information system technology is developed rapidly in the field of electric power production management, including huge data of power equipment and facilities, user data and planning data, showing a certain space and complexity from power generation, transmission, distribution to electricity consumption. Applying the potential advantages of geographic information system technology to the management of power system can organically combine the map, image and attribute data in the power grid management system, thus greatly improving the quality of power and reliability of power supply. This paper emphatically elaborates information integration technology based on the ESB. Applying the spatial data of the power grid GIS platform to the business planning of production management system can not only integrate or inherit the existing power system applications, but also facilitate the expansion of new business system functions, which has good dynamic scalability, realizes the automation and informatization of power grid production management, and provides strong support for the self-healing and reliability of power grid.

articleTitle: A CNN-RNN Based Fake News Detection Model Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: False news has become widespread in the last decade in political, economic, and social dimensions. This has been aided by the deep entrenchment of social media networking in these dimensions. Facebook and Twitter have been known to influence the behavior of people significantly. People rely on news/information posted on their favorite social media sites to make purchase decisions. Also, news posted on mainstream and social media platforms has a significant impact on a particular country’s economic stability and social tranquility. Therefore, there is a need to develop a deceptive system that evaluates the news to avoid the repercussions resulting from the rapid dispersion of fake news on social media platforms and other online platforms. To achieve this, the proposed system uses the preprocessing stage results to assign specific vectors to words. Each vector assigned to a word represents an intrinsic characteristic of the word. The resulting word vectors are then applied to RNN models before proceeding to the LSTM model. The output of the LSTM is used to determine whether the news article/piece is fake or otherwise.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Dijkstra Path Planning Algorithm for Industrial Stacking Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the path planning research of industrial robots, it is necessary to find the shortest path and reduce the search time. In this paper, A* algorithm, Dijkstra algorithm and Dynamic Programming algorithm are used to find the shortest path in the industrial workshop scenario. An improved Dijkstra algorithm is used to add additional paths considering turning angle, scene complexity and device wear.

articleTitle: Vehicle lateral stability control based on sliding model in high-speed sharp turning condition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Vehicle is easy to lose the lateral stability, such as the body yaw and sideslip at high-speed sharp turning condition on the low-adhesion roads. In order to improve vehicle lateral stability at high-speed sharp turning condition, the AFS control strategy based on the variable sliding model is designed. Based on the traditional vehicle ESP controller, the vehicle coordinated control strategy based on the ESP+AFS controller is realized. In the coordinated controller the difference between the actual vehicle yaw angular velocity and the ideal yaw angular velocity is decided as the input variable and the output parameter are the additional front-wheel turning angle of AFS. The measure results show that at high-speed sharp turning conditions on the low-adhesion roads, the ESP+AFS coordinated controller can improve vehicle’s lateral stability.

articleTitle: Small target detection algorithm based on YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has been rapidly developed in the field of target detection. How to accurately and efficiently locate small target objects is one of the main difficulties in target detection research. This paper proposes a small target detection method based on YOLOv4 algorithm. In the process of data preprocessing, the small target enhancement method is used instead of the Mosaic method to increase the number of small targets in the image and improve the small target detection ability of the network model. Using the K-means to get the best size of the anchor box to improve the accuracy and speed of small target detection. Experiments on the DOTA data set show that it meets the performance requirements and can effectively and accurately locate the target object in the image with the accuracy of 93.2%.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Indoor Positioning Accuracy Based on Machine Learning and Particle Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The positioning problem in the indoor environment has always been an unresolved area, and the severe attenuation of the signal and the multipath effect has led to its low positioning accuracy. In this paper, the location fingerprint method is used for indoor positioning. Firstly, the ray tracing technology is used to obtain the indoor positioning experimental data, and then the multiple classification regression algorithms in machine learning are used to carry out experiments respectively. Finally, the Particle Filter (PF) algorithm optimizes the above algorithm. By analyzing the experimental results, it is shown that machine learning combined with the particle filter algorithm can greatly improve the accuracy of indoor positioning.

articleTitle: Design of Conceptual System for Air Intelligent Operations based on DoDAF
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the development of intelligent technology, the future air combat will present the widespread participation of intelligent weapons, and the research on the design of intelligent air combat concepts has become a hot topic in the military field. The DoDAF is the framework of the defense system of the United States, which mainly used the model of DoDAF to design the architecture framework of the intelligent air combat concept, and provides the reference and basis for the following research on the concept of intelligent warfare in the air, which has some military practical significance.

articleTitle: Vehicle braking stability on separate road based on fuzzy PID controller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: It is easy to lose vehicle lateral stability as a vehicle is braking on a separating road, or at the other extreme conditions. To improve a vehicle lateral stability with the urgently high-speed braking on a separated road, a controller is built based on an adaptive fuzzy PID method. A vehicle model of two freedom degree is chosen to analyze the vehicle braking performance. The fuzzy control rules and the control strategies of the adaptive PID controller are proposed. Finally, the PID controller is verified based on the vehicle model from the software of CarSim. The vehicle simulation data of the vehicle yaw angular velocity and the vehicle body roll angle, etc. with the adaptive fuzzy PID controller are used to analyze the vehicle lateral stability. The results show that the fuzzy PID controller optimize the vehicle lateral stability at the urgently high-speed braking on the separated road.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Agv Complex Environment Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the wide application of AGV in all walks of life, the path planning of AGWl has become a research hotspot. Among the traditional algorithms for path planning, ant colony algorithm is provided with good global search capability, adaptability and easy combination. It is suitable to be the core algorithm of AGV path planning. Firstly, the data of surrounding environment is collected through the sensors loaded in the AGV, and the corresponding map is constructed through these collected data. Then, the constructed map is transformed into a two-dimensional grid map required for simulation by using the grid graph method. Meanwhile, the simulation experiment is in progress with MATLAB. Finally, the optimal AGV path simulation results based on ant colony algorithm are obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of technology hotspots in artificial intelligence field based on Patent Map
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: artificial intelligence has become the driving force of leading scientific and technological progress and the new engine of promoting industrial upgrading.In this paper, the research methods of literature and patent map are used to analyze the research hotspots in the field of artificial intelligence.Through the co-occurrence analysis of technology keywords, the status of technology integration in the field of artificial intelligence is studied, and the core technology in this field is identified.Based on the patent map analysis method and the international patent classification of artificial intelligence, this paper analyzes the overall situation of patent applications in the field of artificial intelligence. It is found that big data, cloud computing, speech recognition, image recognition and human-computer interaction are hot technologies in the field of artificial intelligence.Intelligent robot, intelligent medical, intelligent education and other aspects are the future development trend of the industry.This study can provide reference for related enterprises to carry out artificial intelligence technology research and development and forward-looking layout.

articleTitle: Dynamic multi-target trajectory planning of aircraft based on Gaussian pseudo-spectral method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Research aircraft “one-to-multiple” in-orbit debris recovery problem, was proposed based on improved gaussian pseudo-spectral method of spacecraft multi-target trajectory optimization method. Through the strong constraint of the inner point, the multi-stage transition trajectory of the aircraft is guaranteed to be smooth. Based on the Lambert double-pulse model, a strategy to determine the mission time window based on the slope of the time-fuel curve is proposed. The iteration strategy of initial value generator based on PSO algorithm is proposed. The simulation results show that the proposed method has large convergence range, is insensitive to the initial value and has high design accuracy. It is an important method to realize the optimization of multi-target in-orbit debris recovery trajectory.

articleTitle: The influence of constraint method on the finite element simulation for bolted joint
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Due to the difficulty of observation and testing, more and more investigators use finite element method to simulate the loosening process of bolted joint. The influence of different constraint method on the results are discussed in the work. The results show that if the mesh is matched between the two tied parts, the results are the same as that of modelling the two parts as one component. If the mesh is unmatched between the two tied parts, the results have a very slight deviation from that of modelling the two parts as one component.

articleTitle: Design and Intelligent Control of Flexible Limbs of Tower Climbing Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the gecko-like tower climbing robot system, robot limbs play an important role. Based on the system engineering principle, a robot with four flexible limbs is proposed and designed with the functional modules.The structure, position, and state of the hinge end of the robot flexible limb are planned to ensure that any combination of three hinge points from the four determine the correct position of the chassis at any time without interference. During the climbing process, the precise screw mechanism and the front-end sensors are used to judge and obtain the next holding target, and the “W” type sensing region is set to make the discrete small sensing elements form a continuum, so as to ensure that the system can obtain the target information of the handle in real time. Due to help handle arranged on the tower and uneven distribution of handles on the tower, each climbing step, the flexible limb should make readjustment, and the palm and fingers will grasp the handle properly with the pressure-uniform algorithm, not only making the palm center and the handle center overlap, and also adjusting grip strength in reliability.

articleTitle: A New Forest Fire Risk Rating Forecast Model Based on XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) to the forest fire risk rating forecast task and propose a new model based on the XGBoost algorithm with meteorological factors input. Based on the data of Chongqing province, 2016 to 2017, our model provides a convincing importance order which corresponds to the universal awareness. In contrast with traditional methods such as logistic regression (LR) and support vector machine (SVM), our model achieves a higher accuracy of 55.10%, which indicates the superiority of our model.

articleTitle: A new automatic segmentation algorithm for carotid artery ultrasound images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The inner diameter of the carotid artery is an important indicator for predicting the severity of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases (CVDS).In this regard, this paper proposes an efficient and automatic algorithm for computer-aided segmentation of carotid artery inner diameter. This method uses the combination of super-pixel segmentation and the improved least squares fitting ellipse algorithm to segment the image, and realizes the automatic segmentation of the inner diameter of the arterial artery. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is robust to ultrasound image noise, the segmentation results of carotid artery inner diameter have a high consistency with the real value, and it can fit different shapes of blood vessel inner diameters with a fitting accuracy of 93.63%.

articleTitle: Face recognition system design based on ESP32
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the improvement of science and technology, people’s demand for safe and high-speed encryption is more and more urgent. The traditional key unlocking method and the digital keypad password lock unlocking method are not only inconvenient to use in some occasions but also worrying about the security. This design is based on the ESP32 development board, using the way of face recognition unlocking, put forward a face recognition unlocking system design. This system takes ESP32 as the core module, uses ESP-EYE to collect and store images, and then sends them to the computer through the data bus. By comparing the collected and stored image information, the control of peripheral circuit can be realized. The experimental results show that the design cost of the system is low, the operation is convenient, the safety is strong, and has a strong practicability.

articleTitle: Robot grasping target detection method based on YoLov3
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to improve the detection accuracy of robot visual grasping target, and overcome the problems that the traditional target detection technology has low recognition accuracy and can not meet the actual needs due to the disordered placement position, mutual occlusion, small scale and other factors. This paper adopts the popular real-time target detection algorithm YoLov3, and collects a large number of image information samples according to the robot grabbing the target, and labels them into a training set. Through many training and continuous adjustment of parameters, the best capture target detection model is obtained. The experimental results on VOC datasets show that this method has achieved good detection results for different captured target images, and can well meet the needs of practical application.

articleTitle: Research on indoor radio frequency positioning algorithm based on TDOA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper proposes a new TDOA-based positioning algorithm that can be applied to indoor environments. To enhance the degree of exactitude of indoor positioning and control the noise, based on the TDOA algorithm, the extended Kalman filter(EKF) positioning algorithm is constructed, and thus modified to automatic control extended Kalman filter(ACEKF) positioning algorithm, which can maintain good positioning degree of exactitude.

articleTitle: Research on Application and Measurement of Body Scale
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper introduces the application of body scale. By introducing the function diversification of body scale, the measurement industry needs to study and improve the standard instrument and measurement method. The Internet of Things and artificial intelligence technology are used to realize the automatic monitoring of human health by body scale health management system.

articleTitle: ABB-IRB120 Robot Modeling and Simulation Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: A modeling and simulation experiment of robot handling process based on ABB-IRB120 is designed. In view of the inspection work of robot sorting state in the industrial processing process, the traditional inspection method is manual inspection, which is low efficiency, unable to supervise and prone to error. In order to solve the problems of manual inspection, the coordinate system and control equation of the handling robot ABB-IRB120 are established by the standard D-H parameter method. On the establishment of the robot movement model analysis of the forward and inverse solution of the robot, and then the trajectory planning of the robot is studied and calculated, through MATLAB software simulation of the trajectory of the robot, the robot each joint movement curve, the results of analysis, to achieve the kinematics simulation of the robot.

articleTitle: Research Progress Of Bolt Loose Detection Technology Based On Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks have powerful generalization and expression capabilities for extracting deep-level features of images. Their emergence has further promoted the development of artificial intelligence, and greatly improved the image recognition and detection effects and computer operating speed. With the advent of the global intelligent era, image recognition and detection technology based on convolutional neural networks has emerged in various fields of workpiece detection, and it has also brought challenges for professionals in this field to optimize intelligent algorithms. In this paper, the recognition process of the convolutional neural network and the current research status of the convolutional neural network in the recognition of bolt looseness images are described and prospected.

articleTitle: Affective Computing on Speeches of Court Defense Lawyer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Previous researches have shown that the language skills of court defense lawyers play an important role in judges’ and juries’ decision making in favour of the defendant. Based on the acoustic feature parameters optimized by neural activity observations, this paper studied the affective computing method of court defense lawyers’ speeches. The experimental test results showed that this proposed method provided an effective technical approach for describing and analyzing the lawyers’ affective language skills.

articleTitle: Installation Error Calibration Method of INS/CNS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The CNS changes from traditional way of working to the direction of infrared and all-weather. Stray light interference during the day so complicated, is restricted by CNS detectors, Consider the reason, the authors design a Rotary System to achieve capability. So far, In INS/CNS integrated navigation system, for the accuracy of CNS measurement information, the Installation Error Calibration Method of the Integrated System is researched, as the CNS navigation precision is restricted by inertial horizontal reference. With the traditional astronomical calibration method, the installation error is normally calibrated and marked. This paper introduces the calibration principle of the extension equipment of the CNS/INS, and elaborates the calibration process and method of the horizontal deviation and the azimuth deviation in detail. Aiming at the error source in common base calibration, according to the structure of the combined system, the factors affecting the system calibration such as the inclination of the shaft, the coaxial error, the size effect, and the calibration zero are modeled and analyzed.

articleTitle: CBIA Image Recognition Trademark Implementation on Mobile
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Trademark is a kind of mark used by producers and operators of commodities in order to distinguish the commodities produced and operated by themselves from those produced and operated by other commodity producers or operators. This mark is usually composed of words and figures. However, there are numerous kinds of goods in different countries and regions in the world, and there are many corresponding trademarks. How to identify commodity trademarks efficiently and quickly to obtain the meaning behind them, whether for commercial purposes or scientific research purposes, distinguishing different trademarks is of great significance. Trademark cognition can be applied to give consumers an easy and efficient information acquisition experience, promote the transformation from consumers to investors, and greatly facilitate the financial industry’s cognition of trademarks. Different trademarks have their own designs in words and graphics. Because the traditional manual trademark recognition method is time-consuming and labor-intensive, using mobile image pickup technology to directly extract the commodity information behind the trademark has become a very promising research topic. In this paper, CBIA technology based on content-based image analysis is applied to realize the complete function of trademark recognition system on the mobile terminal. According to the photos taken by the mobile terminal, the commodity trademarks in the pictures are recognized, which is suitable for business scenarios that need to quickly obtain brand information. Trademark recognition has been promoted from basic research to practical application.

articleTitle: Research on AHRS attitude algorithm based on magnetic calibration technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to meet the application requirements in the military and civilian fields, AHRS combines a magnetic sensor to improve its’ precision and reduce the dependence on external device. In the paper, the attitude calculation algorithm based on magnetic calibration technology is introduced, and the magnetic calibration method is mainly studied. From the analysis of laboratory test data, the accuracy of AHRS heading angle has been greatly improved, which enhance from 2.19° to 0.27°. Finally, it can be concluded that magnetic calibration algorithm based on the elliptical hypothesis has a good compensation effect for carrier magnetic interference.

articleTitle: Direction-finding array layout optimization technology based on artificial intelligence algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the problem of element arrangement of DF antenna array in reconnaissance equipment, combined with the characteristics of high-speed movement and shape and size of the device, an optimization method of direction finding array arrangement is proposed. According to the relationship between the direction finding accuracy and the position parameters of the array elements, the antenna array layout problem of the direction finding device is transformed into a convex optimization problem about the optimization of the array element position parameters. On the basis of modeling, the weight of convex optimization problem is set according to the requirements of technical scheme, and the most reasonable antenna layout position is obtained through optimization. The optimization method can make the direction finding accuracy close to the lower limit of accuracy as far as possible, and it does not need complicated experimental work. It is easy to realize and is suitable for engineering application.

articleTitle: Research on Leak Location Method of Water Supply Network based on Deep Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The water supply network is one of the important infrastructure in urban construction. It has strong theoretical and practical significance to realize the real-time monitoring and leak location of the water supply network. In this paper, based on the similarity of water supply network node pressure, fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is used to realize the selection of finite monitoring points. On this basis, a depth neural network model is constructed according to the pressure changes of the monitoring points before and after the leakage of the water supply network, so as to locate the leakage points. In the experimental part, hydraulics simulation was conducted by using EPANETH pipe network adjustment software according to the layout structure of water supply network, and the pressure of all nodes was obtained. A deep neural network model was established by Keras in Tensorflow framework. After model training and testing, the training error was controlled within the effective range of 5 %. Finally, the model is applied to the actual leakage problem of underground water supply network in Langxi County of Xuancheng City, and the accurate location of the leakage point is realized. The experiment proves the feasibility and accuracy of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Environmental Sound Classification Algorithm Based on Adaptive Data Padding
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Environmental sound classification (ESC) has important practical significance, such as security monitoring, audio retrieval, etc. However, there are many problems in the field of ESC, which lead to the application in the actual scene is often not up to the ideal situation. In this paper, due to the non-stationary nature of environmental sound and the strong disturbance of environmental noise, an environmental sound classification algorithm based on adaptive data padding is proposed. In this method, the short raw audio data is first filled with random padding method, and then the raw audio data is converted into logmel spectrum, and then the generated logmel spectrum is input into the neural network for training. In this paper, the structure of neural network is reorganized by incremental convolution kernel, and the Batch Normalization (BN) layer is used for data normalization after each convolution layer. Finally, the model is verified based on UrbanSound8K dataset, and the experimental results prove the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on the wireless coverage solution in transformer substations based on WLAN+5G
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grids, wired communication is difficult to achieve comprehensive coverage for large-connection, high mobility, and high bit rate services in substations. In order to solve the communication bottleneck of high bit rate services in substations, this paper conducts a comparative analysis of mainstream large-bandwidth wireless communication technologies, including WLAN, 5G, and LTE-U. To combine the technical advantages of 5G and WLAN, this paper presents a wireless coverage solution in transformer substations based on WLAN+5G. This solution can reduce the difficulty and cost of the deployment and maintenance of WAPI network, and also reduce the cost of 5G network. This WLAN+5G wireless coverage solution is suitable for various types of application scenarios in power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Uncertainty of Calibration of Common Mode Impedance Modulus of Coupling/Decoupling Network Using Electrical Length Compensation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The process and result of the uncertainty evaluation of the precise calibration of the common mode impedance modulus of the coupling/decoupling network (abbreviated as CDN hereafter) for the immunity of conducted disturbances induced by radio-frequency fields in EMC test and measurement technique using electrical length compensation method and the impedance analyzer or the network analyzer as the calibration standard are introduced in this paper. In the beginning of this paper, the calibration method of the common mode impedance modulus of the coupling/decoupling network is presented, and the calculation formula of electric length compensation method is deduced. On the basis of the formula, the sources of the uncertainty of the calibration result of the common mode impedance modulus of the coupling/decoupling network are analyzed, and the corresponding sensitivity coefficients are calculated. At the end of this paper, the process and result of the uncertainty evaluation of the common mode impedance modulus of some model coupling/decoupling network is given.

articleTitle: Research on application of Big Data Technology in SF Express
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the face of massive data emerging every day, the processing ability of big data technology is particularly important.Logistics enterprises can set up their own big data operation center by integrating and analyzing these huge amounts of big data information, in order to mine the hidden data value, thus helps the logistics enterprise to improve the logistics operational efficiency and management level. Taking SF express as an example, this paper analyzes the application of big data technology in logistics enterprises, and puts forward corresponding countermeasures and measures according to the problems existing in the application of big data technology.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Survey Cost of Power Transmission and Transformation Projects Based on FAHP
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper uses the Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process (FAHP) to evaluate the influence of various factors on the change of survey cost. Firstly, we introduce the FAHP model which is constructed based on the analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Secondly, we construct the influencing factors set based on the fishbone diagram which is used to analyze the influencing factors of survey cost. Thirdly, according to the influencing factors of engineering cost change, the hierarchical structure model is constructed. Then we use the FAHP model to analyze influencing factors and determine the weight of each influencing factors. At last, we ensure the influence degree of each factors to the change of survey cost and get some suggestions about survey cost. It provides some help for guiding the reasonable charging of survey fee of power transmission and transformation projects, promoting the standardization of cost and ensuring the safe and stable operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Research and Prospect of 3D Virtual Display Technology of Clothing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the popularization of 5G network and the development of virtual reality technology, clothing display technology is also moving towards the direction of intelligent 3D clothing virtual. This article first analyses the status quo of clothing 3D virtual display technology, and then discusses the four aspects that 3D reconstruction of human body, dynamic deformation of human body, 3D dressing simulation and animation simulation of clothing, and analyses the mainstream technical methods involved in the process of clothing 3D virtual display. Finally, it looks forward to the trend of the technical field and its application prospect in clothing industry.

articleTitle: Design Of Heptagonal Side Pumped Solid State Laser Source
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, the absorption distribution model of laser crystal in multi-side pumped solid-state laser structure is established, and the normalized light field distribution state of absorption field is calculated by using Mathematical calculation software. Two important parameters, chip spacing and radial distance from Nd: YAG emitting surface to surface in diode array are analyzed. The simulation results show that the relative absorption ratio of crystal cross section and pump uniformity are related to the key parameters. Finally, this paper provides theoretical guidance for the design of heptagonal diode pumped solid state laser.

articleTitle: Application of satellite technology in smart grid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Satellite technology has the technical characteristics of all-weather, wide coverage, quasi-real-time,mobility and flexibility. In recent years, smart grids have developed rapidly, and the technical characteristics of satellite technology have increasingly met the application requirements of smart grids. This paper summarizes the classification of the satellites and the application scenarios of the satellite technology in power grid. This paper emphatically introduces the technical characteristics of high-throughput satellite, and discusses its application in the remote control device test of the newly-built substations..

articleTitle: Simulation of UAV single target location and tracking based on TLD algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: People’s quality of life is constantly improving and the level of science and technology is advancing by leaps and bounds. Facing the increasingly complex tasks, these tasks inevitably have various dangers. Let the robot complete these tasks, so that the robot has gradually become an irreplaceable part in people’s life. For example, in the prevention and tracking of security incidents in public places, the monitoring range of ground cameras to targets is seriously limited and can not record the complete trajectory of criminals. This paper mainly proposes a novel tracking strategy, which uses UAV to locate and track a single target, which can locate and track all kinds of targets more efficiently and accurately.

articleTitle: Multi-beam Bathymetric measurement error analysis based on Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Multi-beam depth system is developed from single-frequency depth system, which is a new technique of underwater topographic measurement with high efficiency, high precision and high resolution. Compared with the traditional single beam depth meter, multi-beam depth system has many advantages, such as large range, high speed, high precision, digital recording and image-making automation, so that underwater topographic measurement technology has developed to a new level. This paper expounds the measurement principle and composition of multi-beam depth system, as well as the data processing method, and analyzes the motion compensation method for multi-beam depth system based on combined conductivity. This paper first studies the error factors of multi-beam depth measurement system, combines the combined inertial navigation system to explore the impact of various errors on the measurement results, simulates the use of combined inertial guidance system to assist multi-beam depth measurement data to obtain high-precision high-reliability measurement data, and finally summarizes the development and application of the current multi-beam technology.

articleTitle: An efficient self-certified scheme based on discrete logarithms and factoring for MANETs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The self-certified scheme has some unique merits comparing with certificate-based and identity-based scheme. This scheme proposes a self-certified authentication scheme based on discrete logarithm and factoring which employ Rabin signature system to generate user public keys for mobile ad hoc networks(MANETs), and which realizes one-way authentication between nodes. The analysis shows that the online interactive data of the protocol can effectively prevent the leakage of verification information, and has certain security and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Face Pose Estimation Method for Virtual Try-on System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper proposes a 3D face pose estimation algorithm based on feature points, which realizes the angle estimation of human faces in any pose. It can accurately estimate within 30 degrees on 6 degrees of freedom, and provides the algorithm basis for a subsequent real 3D try-on.

articleTitle: Main Structure Extraction Algorithm Based on Relative Total Variation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Extracting main structure from texture images is a basic process in computer vision and graphics applications. Aiming at solving the problems that the relative total variation model (RTV) algorithm is not easy to implement on hardware and blurs the edges when filtering out the texture, an improved relative total variation model algorithm is proposed. First, the reciprocal function is used to replace the exponential form of the weight function in the original algorithm, which is convenient for hardware implementation. Then, on the basis of the original spatial relation, the relation between gradient value is added into the weight function, so as to avoid the misjudgment between the main structure pixel and texture pixel and effectively maintain the edge. The experimental results show that the improved RTV model makes the difference in the value of the windowed inherent variation between main structure and texture more obvious and the edge preserving ability is better than the original algorithm. Moreover, the effect of extracting main structure from texture images is better than other similar algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Intelligent Management System for Morchella Planting Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This article is based on the Arduino controller and Linkboy integrated development system, APP Inventor and the Internet of Things platform of Bafa Cloud, and uses the Internet of Things system for intelligent management of morels cultivation as research. The morels planting management Internet of Things application system is based on the needs of the morels planting environment, using the microcontroller series single-chip Arduino2560 as the core system to collect the temperature, humidity, soil humidity, light, wind and other data of the morel growth environment and use The WIFI module ESP32 performs network transmission, combined with the Bafa Cloud Internet of Things platform, mobile phone App, mobile WIFI and solar energy conversion system, to realize the all-weather temperature and humidity, light, wind, soil humidity, etc. of Morels in the wild planting management Indicator monitoring, through local or remote control of the humidity and soil water content in the area, to achieve real-time monitoring and control of morel growth indicators.

articleTitle: Joint Decision-making of Order Selection and Scheduling in Hybrid Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of order selection and scheduling in mixed assembly line, this paper takes the maximization of the total profit of the workshop as the optimal goal, comprehensively considers the factors such as order priority and finished goods inventory, and constructs a joint decision-making model of production order selection and scheduling, and solves the model by lingo. The results of case study show that the joint decision of order selection and scheduling in mixed assembly line can significantly improve the company's profit, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Study on optimization of Flow Line Production Based on the Genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The issue of vaccine flow line production was studied according to the actual flow line production requirements. In view of this issue, we took the minimum total production time as the objective, and built a 0-1 non-linear planning model under the premise of ensuring production reliability; optimized the same with the genetic algorithm. By selecting appropriate population initialization and adaptability function, we enabled it was not limited to local optimality and achieved the reduction in the number of iterations. The results show that the improved genetic algorithm can save about 2.3% of production time. On this basis, the total production time was further reduced to calculate the completion probability of the flow line tasks. Besides, the relationship between the reduced time proportion and the completion probability was simulated.

articleTitle: Extrusion force calculation and structure optimization of new flat-cone die
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the aluminium alloy extrusion process, the extrusion force is one of the important parameters. Generally speaking, under the premise of ensuring the feasibility of the process and the quality of the profile, it is hoped that the extrusion force is as small as possible. Based on the traditional extrusion die structure, a new flat cone die is designed. The finite element method is used to calculate the extrusion force during the extrusion process of 7075 aluminium alloy bars, and the key structural dimensions of the new flat-cone die are optimized. The calculation results show that the extrusion force of the new flat taper die is small under the premise of good product quality.

articleTitle: Study on an Automatic Levelling and Positioning Control System Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Many devices need a high-precision horizontal platform during normal operation, and sometimes the horizontal position of the platform needs to be adjusted, such as the isolation switch mechanism box in the power system. In the past, manual adjustment was commonly used, which led to the low efficiency and accuracy. This paper proposes an automatic control system for a four-legged platform based on programmable logic controller (PLC) and positioning module. The principle of levelling is analyzed and the strategy of raising legs in one direction is proposed which make control easy and efficient. The hardware and software of the control system are designed for this system. The experiment is carried out and the results show that the system can quickly adjust the level and horizontal position of the platform, with the functions of virtual leg detecting and limit protection.

articleTitle: Modern intelligent logistics management paradigm based on management information system model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The functional design of logistics information system should satisfy the establishment of an information platform that can scientifically manage and maintain logistics information, and provide a unified multi-source data service. The novelty of the presented idea can be separated into the two major core aspects. (l)The use of MIS in logistics industry can effectively deal with traditional problems,in order to operate efficiently in intelligent logistics management, management model should be constructed characterized by wireless sensor monitoring network, safety and reliability,closed loop of logistics service.(2)RFID technology can track the quality and dynamic process quickly, which is helpful to improve the quality control level of products in the process of circulation. Finalized model designed based on the above technology is aim to set further directions in intelligent logistics management.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Method of the College Professional Admission Scores
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This article is based on the web crawler technology to obtain the admission scores of some colleges and universities in various provinces, and integrate it with the existing college professional admission scores. The edit distance algorithm and the mean difference interpolation method are used to clean the data of similar duplicate records and missing records respectively. Using BP neural network theory and support vector machine algorithm to construct a network model with 9 characteristics of school, major, province, batch, discipline, average score, highest score, provincial control line and year as input, and the lowest score as output. Using labeling coding to encode non-numerical data to normalize the data. Preset 1% and 2% minimum score error bands and compare the pass rates predicted by two models in different preset error bands. Obtained that both models meet the preset 2% error, But within the 1% error band, the network model constructed based on the SVM algorithm has higher accuracy and the forecasting effect is better.

articleTitle: Forecast Research For Non-liner Rolling Motion of Damaged Warship
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The paper establishes mathematics model of the non-liner rolling motion to damaged warship, and simulate type II flooded warship’s rolling motion under excitation of regular waves applying numerical simulation. Then study the influence of different parameters to rolling motion chaos response domain. The results suggest that rolling motion of flooded warship has many different motion form, which is likely to single frequency, multi-frequency or combined frequency. Chaos may be in certain terms by rolling motion.

articleTitle: Design of a sorting and recycling system for post-consumer bottles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The recycling of discarded bottles can save resources and avoid pollution. The current machinery of recycling is faced with high cost or large manual operation. Furthermore, it cannot deal with complex classification types and environmental problems. A designment of sorting and recycling system couple with Res2net combining attention mechanism with label smoothing methods is identified and classified for different types of post-consumer bottles, the result shows that the recognition accuracy of this way has been improved. The attention mechanism and label smoothing method can not only reduce the data disturbance at the initial training stage, but also improve the accuracy. This program was tested, and its recall rate and accuracy rate reached the highest, which were respectively 91.70% and 94.16%.

articleTitle: Research on the on-line maintenance technology of the battery for communication power supply
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The overcharge, undercharge, and overdischarge of the battery will cause the consistency of the cells in the battery pack to deteriorate, thereby affecting the overall discharge performance and greatly reducing the normal working time of the battery.However, there is no suitable means to maintain the battery for overcharging, undercharging, overdischarging, and aging activation. In this paper, an online maintenance technology for lead-acid batteries is studied. By applying this technology, the problems of overcharge, undercharge and over discharge of the battery are avoided, and the corrosion and vulcanization of the battery plate are slowed down to a certain extent. This on-line maintenance technology can effectively reduce the failure rate and elimination rate of the battery, and reduce the replacement and maintenance cost of the battery.

articleTitle: Inertial Derivative Data Storage System Based on STM32H743
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: An inertial derivative data storage system based on STM32H743 is designed. MPU6050 gyroscope accelerometer, GPS and other sensors are used to compose the inertial navigation system. After transplantation of FATFS file system, data can be stored through NAND FLASH storage medium, and data can be read through USB interface. This auxiliary debugging system has the advantages of small size, accurate data and strong processing ability. From the principle, design scheme, software implementation and other aspects of the realization of the explanation.

articleTitle: Verification, calibration and application of electronic balances
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the compulsory verification of electronic balances, the calibration of its measurement results, the evaluation method of uncertainty and its application in different fields.

articleTitle: Research on Component Retrieval and Matching Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Aiming at how to quickly retrieve the target component from the huge component library, this paper proposes a component retrieval method based on facet classification, which uses component keyword set to facet description of the component and constructs the component vectorized model. The idea of layering is adopted to divide the components in detail. The K-means clustering algorithm based on the maximum and minimum distances is used to cluster the components, so that the problem of component matching is transformed into the calculation of the cosine similarity of component vectors. This method can narrow down the search scope and effectively improve the search efficiency.

articleTitle: The current situation and development of Large Mass Weights value transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the application of large mass weights and the current situation and development of measurement in China. The function of mechanical balance in traceability of mass weights is introduced.

articleTitle: Experimental study on carbothermal reduction of zinc dust in molten state
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to achieve the selective reduction of electric furnace dust and the effective separation of iron and zinc resources, Factsage thermodynamic simulation and experimental research are combined. The changes of Gibbs free energy of valuable metal elements in molten state were analyzed. This paper studied the effect of slag phase on the melting temperature and viscosity, and the amount of residual zinc in the slag and iron phase after the reduction of the molten state. The simulation shows that SiO2 can be used to reduce the melting point of slag. Changing the content of FeO can effectively suppress the increase in viscosity caused by the addition of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and the residual zinc content in the slag-iron phase after molten reduction after changing the dust slag system is 0.0046 wt.% and 0.012 wt.%, respectively.

articleTitle: SIMGAT: A Sentiment Analysis Model Based on Graph Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the normalization of social media, the popularization of Chinese, how to effectively enable computers to recognize Chinese short-text messages is an important task for network public opinion management and control. Due to the complexity of social media, information between people will have mutual influence, that is, short-text information is interrelated and can be described as a form of graph data. This paper is based on the method of graph neural network for Chinese sentiment analysis, and proposes a method based on improved graph attention mechanism to learn the semantic and structural information between short-text content, and at the same time aggregate short-text information from the field, so as to effectively express the emotional context. The experimental results show that, compared with the existing methods, the graph-based sentiment analysis model is very effective, and the attention mechanism shows a better effect on the sentiment analysis task of short-text.

articleTitle: Speed Correction Technology of SSINS Based On Gravity Anomalies
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: High-precision, high-reliability autonomous navigation of sea-based underwater carrier platform is the key technology to realize national marine strategy, with the continuous development and perfection of inertial elements and their inertial guidance technology, the way to describe the earth’s gravity field with a simple reference spheroid limits the performance of high-precision space-stabilized inertial navigation system(SSINS) to further improve, seriously restricts the launch accuracy of ship-based weapons, especially when the sea-based underwater carrier cruises, the vertical deviation of gravity may cause speed error in the horizontal loop of its inertial guidance system. This paper briefly describes the basic principles of high-precision spatially stable inertial navigation system, and discusses the relationship between its inertial guidance system, gravity data acquisition and gravity anomalies. It is analyzed that the level weight of accelerometer is disturbed by gravity error. On this basis, combined with the high-precision inertial navigation system, the gravity vector measurement scheme and the characteristics of the analytical measurement method are proposed, the influence relationship of gravity vector anomalies on the accuracy of space-stabilized inertial navigation system is deduled, the error analysis and simulation verification are carried out for the correction technology, and a reference is provided for the speed optimization design of the inertial/gravity combination system.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Ethical in Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With development of social economy, science and technology has got rapid development, and it becomes the inevitable choice of the trend in nowadays. Artificial intelligence is more and more penetrating into People’s life, however in artificial intelligence, bring convenience to people will bring lots of ethical questions in the meantime. And while increasing the investment in science and technology, the research on ethics and law closely related to it is relatively lagging behind. The research is to explore the ethical issues of artificial intelligence in environmental protection. This article uses the method of literature research to analyze the ethical issues of artificial intelligence in environmental protection. The ethical problems faced by artificial intelligence include the lack of subject morality, which leads to ethical conflicts in decision-making, a crisis of trust, and its hidden dangers in information security. In this regard, it is necessary to strengthen the rationality of the ethical decision-making process of enterprises in the development and application of artificial intelligence, strengthen corporate ethical leadership, and design internal privacy protection procedures to make artificial intelligence better benefit mankind.

articleTitle: A Study on the optimization of Multi-cycle and Multi-source Procurement and Transport of Enterprises Based on the Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Enterprises put forward higher requirements on selection of raw material suppliers and forwarders, while minimizing product costs in real production. Aiming at optimization of multi-source and multi-cycle suppliers and forwarders, we established an evaluation system first by selecting evaluation indicators with the multiple link relatives method and the TOPSIS method; then built a multi-objective optimization model for selection of suppliers and forwarders with consideration of the transport loss rate, based on the objectives of the most economical cost of raw materials and the least transport loss, under the premise that the stock can support normal production; optimized and improved the sifting operator of the genetic algorithm; and analyzed the effect and feasibility of the implementation.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Model with Cardinality Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the field of database research, query optimization is an important part. Cardinality estimation is a critical problem in query optimization. Reasonable and accurate cardinality estimation can make it easier for the query optimizer to produce a good connection order and guide the cost estimation of the query optimizer. This paper focuses on using the unsupervised method to deal with the cardinality estimation problem, learning the specific distribution in the data table through unsupervised learning, and producing good cardinality estimation results. At the same time, it also experimented with the distribution of actual data and finally achieved good experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Garment Fit through CLO 3D Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to improve the fit of online customized garments, this paper used Makehuman to produce virtual models and CLO 3D to produce virtual garments models. Firstly, the relationship model among virtual body size, garment size and garment fit degree was obtained by subjective evaluation. Then, CLO 3D software was used to read the pressure values of different parts corresponding to different fit garments. Logistic regression analysis was carried out to obtain the relationship model between pressure value and garment fit degree, which can be used to improve garment fit.

articleTitle: Modeling of RF Injection Simulation System for Netted Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper introduces a RF simulation modeling method for netted radar countermeasures. The simulation model adopts RF injection mode, which can simulate three Netted Radars realistically. Each radar includes the electromagnetic environment of radar EW, and is equipped with target echo simulation channel, active jamming injection channel, support jamming injection channel and passive jamming channel. The physical model can complete the laboratory simulation evaluation of jamming effect of multiple electronic jamming devices and passive jamming devices to netted radar with high fidelity.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Sensor Calibration Device Based on Computer Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
