abstract: This paper introduces a new type of sensor calibration device for force generating device. The device is developed based on computer control system. The measurement results are used for computer software to analyze and judge the measurement performance of human scale, which provides technical basis for the measurement and manufacture of weighing instrument.

articleTitle: Intelligent tracking car system based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the rapid development of science and technology in the 21st century, automation equipment has gradually entered people’s lives widely with the rapid development. In this design, the intelligent car uses TC264D as the core control module. It uses the camera to detect the track information, and obtains the middle line of the track according to the connected domain extraction. Inductance coils are used to collect electromagnetic information, and infrared ranging modules are used to assist in judging elements such as ramps and roadblocks. In the process of the smart car running, the encoder obtains the speed of the smart car by collecting the rotational speed of the tire. According to the collected data, the SCM controls the speed of the driving motor through the PI control algorithm, and the PD algorithm and the fuzzy control control the steering gear Angle, realizing the closed-loop control of the intelligent car motor and steering gear. At the same time, use the host computer, keys, IPS LCD module and other debugging tools to debug. Finally, the car can complete the automatic tracking driving, the speed reaches 2m/s.

articleTitle: Research on common view time frequency transfer based on RINEX format observation data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: GNSS common view time frequency transfer technology, satellite bidirectional time frequency transfer technology and precise single point positioning technology are the current long-distance high-precision time-frequency comparison technology.In this paper, we use RINEX format common view data to compare the time and frequency of common view. This method obtains a data point in 30s. Compared with the traditional common view comparison method using cggtts data, this method has higher frequency.This paper evaluates the performance of cggtts data and RINEX data in frequency stability calculation. The results show that the frequency stability of cggtts format data is 1.7e-l29600s, 2.0e-l386400s and 5e-l4. The frequency stability of 960s is 8.6e-l3 9600s is 1.5e-l3 86400s is 2.3e-l4 calculated by RINEX format data. According to the monitoring of the measured frequency source, the 960s frequency stability of the measured frequency source is 1.2e-l29600s, the frequency stability is 1.6e-l386400s, and the frequency stability is 2.0e-l4. The results show that the frequency stability calculated by RINEX format data is closer to the real results.

articleTitle: Application of I/O Module Based on CANopen in Vibration Test-bed
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In view of the increasingly complex industrial field environment, the increasing requirements for communication reliability and real-time, and the increasing domestic demand for I/O modules with CANopen communication interface. A configurable remote I/O module based on CANopen communication protocol is designed. The chip STM32F407ZET6 is selected as the core component to complete the design of the system schematic diagram $\mu$C/OS-II operating system can schedule tasks better, and realize CANopen communication on this basis. Finally, the communication test and analysis of the module are carried out, and the module is applied to the vibration test-bed.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Radar Network RF Injection Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Based on the RF injection hardware in the loop simulation technology, a simulation system of netted radar is established. The distributed networking mode is adopted. Each sub radar transmits the target track information to the fusion center. The hardware platform and software processing flow of the fusion processing center are mainly studied. Data alignment, track association, track fusion and eliminating false tracks are completed in the fusion center to form a global navigation Trace treatment. The simulation test is carried out on the hardware in the loop simulation test platform of distributed netted radar, which provides the design basis for the countermeasure method of netted radar.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Cloud Computing in Power Consumption Information Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the development of the power Internet of things, higher requirements are imposed on the data processing of distribution network. The traditional Oracle database can no longer withstand the increasing data pressure of the power consumption information acquisition system, so it is urgent to alter the system. This paper uses cloud computing technology to transform the power consumption information acquisition system in distribution network. By setting business process verification scenarios to simulate the use of electricity information collection and storage experiments, the feasibility of business migration to the cloud and the cloud platform’s performance advantage are verified. Moreover, the security of the cloud platform architecture is analyzed, and the results show that the cloud computing technology can provide a certain level of support for the existing power consumption information acquisition system.

articleTitle: Weighted expected value operators on fuzzy numbers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The expected value operator is a widely used defuzzifier on fuzzy numbers. It treats each $\alpha$-cut equally. In theory and applications, it is often necessary to reflect the differences of the importance of the $\alpha$-cuts. To this aim, we introduce the weighted expected value operators from fuzzy numbers to □, which allow weighting the $\alpha$-cuts. It’s shown that the weighted expected value operators are defuzzifiers and that they are additive and scale invariant. Furthermore, we investigate the continuity of the weighted expected value operators according to two types of hyperspace metrics: the sendograph metric and the endograph metric, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of DC Motor and Stepping Motor Controllers Based on MSP432P401R MCU
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper designs DC motor and stepping motor controllers based on MSP432P401R micro-controller unit (MCU). MSP432P401R alleviated MCU generates pulse width modulation (PWM) signal, which controls the speed of DC motor through DC motor drive chip module. In this paper, the driver module of DC motor is DRV8833, which forms the DC motor control system together with MCU. The PWM duty cycle can be adjusted via programming to complete the control and speed regulation of the motor. This design makes the MSP432P401R internal timer generate PWM signal with different duty cycle through programming, and the key is implemented to control the PWM signal duty cycle. Then, the MCU sends the PWM signal to the DRV8833 module, counts through the built-in ADC module, and displays the DC motor speed on the OLED screen. At the same time, this design makes the MSP432P401R internal timer generate four PWM signals with different duty cycles through programming. These PWM signals are sent to the motor driver DRV8833 module to change the stepping motor speed via changing the PWM output frequency. Then the speed of the stepping motor can be calculated via the frequency, and the speed of the stepping motor is displayed on the OLED screen.

articleTitle: A Method of Design and Control for Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The autonomy of intelligent mobile robot is not strong enough, and the traditional control methods are insufficient. According to these, a design and control method for intelligent mobile robot is proposed based on microprocessor. The architecture and hardware circuit of mobile robot control system are designed, and an improved PID control method is used for planning the mobile path of robot. The software platform of the system is developed based on codewarrrior IDE development environment, and the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation experiments. The experimental results show that the recommended algorithm can achieve mobile effect quickly and accurately for the robot.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Information Network enhanced Academic Paper Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Academic paper recommender (APR) systems that assist researchers in solving the information overload problem have attracted lots of attention. Recently, many works have been done to improve APR with heterogeneous information network (HIN). However, these works plainly depend on graph embedding to generate recommendations and achieve unsatisfactory performance due to the neglect of high-order paper connectivity in the HIN and complex interactions between the user and academic papers. This paper proposes a new algorithm named Heterogeneous Information Network enhanced Academic Paper Recommendation (HIN-APR) to address the above problems. Firstly, based on the message-passing architecture of GNN, designing a novel heterogeneous graph neural network including dual-level attention is to learn the paper’s high-order feature in HIN. Then, the high-order feature was integrated into a new recommendation framework based on convolution neural network (CNN) to model the complex interactions and predict matching score between users and papers. Experimental results on citeulike-a and citeulike-t show that our proposed approach outperforms compared with baseline methods.

articleTitle: Trust Management Architecture for a Space Dispersed Computing Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: To facilitate the next generation of scientific missions, spacecraft must possess advanced processing capabilities to support computation-intensive and time-sensitive tasks. The core capability of the next generation space information network is computing. However, network security can become compromised in the pursuit of network exposure and openness. Trustability is an important goal of future space information networks. In this paper, trust management architecture for a space dispersed computing network (SDCN) is proposed for the first time. The layered structure is designed from the perspectives of trusted authentication, network transmission, distributed consensus, collaborative computing, and verification audit. The principle-based aspects of each layer are then discussed to improve the security and trustability of the SDCN. In addition, the effective combination of trusted architecture with typical space task scenarios is also discussed.

articleTitle: Construction of Triplet Error Model and Double Norm Algorithm for Two-color Sole Molded Parts
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of automation and intelligent production of sole molded parts, a novel process with robot is realized, replacing manual operation. In the molding process of two-color sole, compared with manual operation, the robot operation requires reliable automatic detection and identification according to the technical conditions and appropriate methods specifically for the two-color sole. In this paper, based on the analysis of the working drawing of the workpiece, the triple model construction is put forward for double color sole molded parts. The perfect model, the tolerance model, and the actual measured model are employed to check the qualification of these parts with the matrix of selected points on the sole through the discrete array of “plum pattern”. Double norm algorithms are adopted for color A sole and color B sole, respectively, between the tolerated model and the actual error model in inspection. For different manufacturing precisions, the adjacent points are interpolated by cubic spline function, thus forming a continuous selected line, realizing not only the qualification inspection but also the flexible inspection for even higher accuracy measurement.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation index system and evaluation model of power market in China
publicationTitle: 2022 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the construction process of China's power market, some problems in the operation process of the power market are gradually highlighted. The establishment of an effective and comprehensive power market evaluation system and evaluation method can reflect the overall situation of the power market, which play an important role in ensuring the efficient and safe operation of the power market. This paper proposes a multi-level comprehensive evaluation system of power market from five aspects of fairness, security, economy, environmental protection and supervision. At the same time, the combination model of AHP and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is constructed, which is an organic combination of qualitative analysis and quantitative calculation. Finally, a simulation example is used to demonstrate the evaluation process of power market, and the results show that the comprehensive evaluation model constructed in this paper is applicable.
